title: Khalil Mack trying to be where his "feet are at" amid trade rumors

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Khalil Mack trying to be where his "feet are at" amid trade rumors
sources.description: The Chargers slumped to another defeat on Sunday and most of the attention being paid to the 0-7 team concerns who is going to be hitting the road in the near future.
